summary: A static build: Astro on the frontend, hosted on Netlify for about $0 a month; no backend or database is needed. It gives search engines full HTML pages and serves pre-built files, so there is no server for a solo developer to run.

frontend.justification: Astro is the frontend for a Content / blog / marketing (SEO) project with about 600 daily users (~0.2 requests/s at peak), built by a solo developer in 2 weeks. Search visibility is marked critical (organic traffic is the business), and it serves full HTML from the server or the build (SEO 5.0/5), so crawlers read the content without running JavaScript. It leads the runner-up, SvelteKit, by 1.1 stack points (points of the overall stack score, the average of the four layer scores).
